messages:
samira-cs: Customer (acme-42) reports Dashboard "Business Overview" graphs never finish loading — browser console shows 503 from analytics API. Screenshot + gist sent.

kai-support: Can you grab the exact network response body and correlation id?

samira-cs: Network snippet: `GET /api/v1/analytics/query 503` response: `{"error":"upstream_error","correlation_id":"c-20251103-81b2"}` Time: 2025-11-03T18:05:54Z. Happens for multiple dashboards and users.

analytics-bot: Alert: spike in 5xx for analytics-api (/v1/analytics/query). p95 latency jumped to 11.6s. alert-id: an-5521

ops-oncall: I'm looking at analytics-proxy. Grepping for cid c-20251103-81b2.

alek-engineer: We shipped a change to aggregator fanout yesterday that increased shard_parallelism. Possible backend saturation. Search aggregator logs for long-running queries.

samira-cs: Proxy log:
```
2025-11-03T18:05:52Z proxy-1 INFO req org=acme-42 path=/v1/analytics/query cid=c-20251103-81b2
2025-11-03T18:05:53Z proxy-1 WARN backend connections exhausted queued=96
2025-11-03T18:05:54Z proxy-1 ERROR upstream timeout 503 cid=c-20251103-81b2
```

marta-ps: Customer wants ETA and whether a rollback is possible. I'll tell them we're investigating and will update in 15m.

ops-oncall: Short-term: increase proxy backend pool to 250 and enable circuit-breaker for very long queries. Applying pool bump to proxy-1 and proxy-2 now.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: config/proxy-pool-increase by ops-oncall. Targets: proxy-1, proxy-2.

ops-oncall: Pool size increased. Watching metrics — 5xx rate decreasing. p95 dropping.

alek-engineer: I'll prepare aggregator patch to reduce shard_parallelism to 6 and add per-request semaphore. Cutting a canary build.

samira-cs: Customer reports some panels reloaded, others still blank. They appreciate the update.

deploy-bot: CI green for patch/aggregator-fanout-throttle. Ready for canary.

ops-oncall: Canary rollout to aggregator-canary-a. Observing 10m.

analytics-bot: Post-deploy check: canary shows no 5xx increase; request latency improved for sampled queries.

ops-oncall: Promoting patch to 100% now. Will keep pool bump for 1 hour then revert.

marta-ps: Drafting final customer message: "Root cause: recent fanout change caused proxy connection pool exhaustion for heavy dashboard queries. Mitigation: temporary pool increase; permanent fix: reduced fanout + per-request throttles."

samira-cs: Sending customer update with ETA ~45 minutes for full resolution. They asked for postmortem.

analytics-bot: Alert cleared: analytics-api 5xx returned to normal. incident-id an-5521 resolved.

ops-oncall: Follow-ups: 1) revert temp pool change in 1h, 2) implement autoscaling for proxy pools, 3) add synthetic test for high-fanout dashboards. Opening JIRA INC-7890.

samira-cs: Customer confirmed dashboards now load and left :thumbsup:. Closing the support ticket after PM sends postmortem.
